title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Spec Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Spec Sheet
options.thesis: Peter’s career reads as a living RFC: precise sections, quiet claims, email as the action line.
options.viewport: Full-bleed paper sheet: Peter Chen at decisive scale, one-line hands-on thesis, email as the only primary action, then experience as numbered sections.
options.risk: Can feel corporate-doc if section rhythm stays flat.

raised.raise: Ma between sections: charged empty space earns the denser proof blocks.
Accent stays on edges and links; body text stays quiet and muted.
Focus one project at a time; siblings dim until selected.
First viewport is one continuous document field, not a header over content.
Identity line holds architectural scale without all-caps shout.
Unequal section weight: recent ownership reads heavier than older roles.

options.label: Wall Label
options.lineage: museum object captions and wall labels
options.thesis: The work leads as the artifact; Peter’s name and role sit as the quiet caption.
options.viewport: A featured project plate dominates the first viewport; name, hands-on line, and email sit as a caption strip.
options.risk: Also the direction most portfolio runs land on: familiar museum calm.

options.label: Ikebana Ma
options.thesis: Career as an asymmetric arrangement: three proof stems, charged empty plaster as ma.
options.viewport: Off-center name; three project lines forming a triangle; large quiet field left empty on purpose.
options.case: Holds clarity for a minimalist brief; hiring managers may not identify with the alcove ritual.
options.risk: Emptiness can read unfinished if the three stems lack weight.

options.label: Cloud Edge
options.thesis: Quiet achromatic field with color only at a hairline fringe.
options.viewport: Wide quiet margins; spectral edge as the only color event.
options.case: Loses identification and clarity once pastel fringe fights the pinned three-color system.
options.kept: Accent confined to edges and links; body text stays quiet.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: Career as one frozen collision: projects as tracks through detector rings.
options.viewport: Concentric career rings with project tracks radiating out.
options.case: Loses both axes: obscure metaphor for hiring, fights simple structure.
options.kept: Focus one project at a time; siblings dim.
options.risk: Science visualization costume over a résumé.

options.label: Shader Portal
options.thesis: Full-bleed living shader with thin type floating over pixels.
options.viewport: GPU scene fills the screen; identity as thin overlay.
options.case: Loses both axes against a simple, proof-led portfolio brief.
options.kept: First viewport as one continuous environmental field.

options.label: Street Poster
options.thesis: Architectural wood-type shout cropped by the frame.
options.viewport: Oversized name cropped by the edge.
options.case: Conflicts with the brief’s avoid-all-caps and quiet voice.
options.kept: Decisive identity-line scale without the shout.
options.risk: All-caps noise against an elegant brief.

options.label: Blast Page
options.thesis: Stacked typographic slabs and hard rules as the only hit.
options.viewport: Section titles as unequal type slabs, no imagery.
options.case: Loses identification for a hiring visitor seeking calm signal.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Centered name, role line, project cards, and social row — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Hero identity block, then a three-up project grid, contact in the footer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other engineer portfolios by design.
